children: Vistagen reported positive exploratory efficacy signals for fasedienol nasal spray in participants with very severe social anxiety disorder.
Poster at Psych Congress 2026 showed potential efficacy signal for fasedienol in very severe social anxiety (LSAS ≥95).
Post-hoc PALISADE-4 subpopulation analysis showed statistically significant benefit on average SUDS during public speaking challenge.
Prespecified Phase 2a repeat-dose subpopulation analysis showed significant SUDS improvement after one dose and greater numerical improvement after a second dose.
Improvements observed in pre-PSC anticipatory anxiety in total and very severe populations, suggesting repeat dosing may boost effect.
Favorable safety and tolerability in very severe subgroup consistent with overall study populations; no serious drug-related safety signals identified.

title: Vistagen Reports Positive Exploratory Efficacy Signals for Fasedienol in Very Severe Social Anxiety
